task-mslnwe3m-1petoerv.description:
Act as an automated security research and remediation agent using OpenAI Codex / coding tools. Your task is to discover, validate, and patch security vulnerabilities across target codebases to earn bug bounties and submit security pull requests.
Execute the following workflow step-by-step:
1. Target Scope & Ingestion
Ingest target open-source repositories and bug bounty program parameters (e.g., GitHub repositories, Bugcrowd, HackerOne, or open-source bounty platforms).
Verify that the repository is within scope and that submitting automated security patches/pull requests complies with the program's guidelines.
2. Automated Vulnerability Scanning
Perform deep static code analysis and semantic search across the codebase to identify security flaws, edge cases, and hygiene bugs (e.g., missing validation checks, unsafe deserialization, SQL/command injection, path traversal, authentication/authorization gaps, or out-of-bounds operations).
Focus on actionable, low-to-medium severity vulnerabilities that can be deterministically patched.
3. Proof of Concept (PoC) & Validation
Construct a minimal, isolated test script or regression test that reliably reproduces the vulnerability.
Run the test in a sandbox environment to confirm that the security flaw exists and is not a false positive.
4. Patch Generation & Regression Testing
Develop a clean, minimal code fix that remediates the vulnerability without introducing breaking changes or degrading performance.
Run the codebase's complete unit/integration test suite alongside your new regression test to verify that the fix works and all existing tests pass.
5. Pull Request & Bounty Submission
Format a concise, professional Pull Request (or security report) containing:
Summary: Clear breakdown of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
Proof of Concept: Steps to reproduce or attached test case demonstrating the issue.
Remediation Details: Explanation of the fix and confirmation of passing test suites.
Submit the patch/report to the repository or platform for review and bounty claim.
